_doc: Money management per account (owner 2026-09-18). STRATEGY lives in
code and is the SAME for every account - only what is listed here may
differ. Change a number, and the bots pick it up within a minute; no
restart, no code edit.
'extends' inherits every field of another package, so a new offer is
usually two lines. Add an account to 'accounts' to put it on a package;
an account that is not listed gets 'base'.
RESTART REQUIRED. The loader re-reads this file every 60 s, but a bot
resolves its package ONCE at import and keeps the values as module
constants - so nothing here reaches a RUNNING bot. Change a dial, then
restart that account's structure_bos_bot.py. (Corrected 2026-09-20; the
old note here claimed no restart was needed, which was never true.)
day_cap        stop opening once today's REALISED profit reaches this
(waived while the account owes money). null = no cap.
max_trades_day how many trades a day this package allows. null = no cap.
week_target    shown at startup, informational only.
base_lot       lot per signal.  max_extra: recovery bullets on top.
kill_net       close everything and stop at this net loss.
max_risk_pct   no single trade may risk more than this share of balance.
debt_mode      'hwm' = debt is the drawdown from the peak.
'half' = half of each loss is added to the debt.
nervosity  false = this account ignores the nervosity brake. Owner's live A/B of 2026-09-18: Valere keeps it, Kino runs without it, everything else identical.
movement   false = this account ignores the movement brake too (no big move in 2 h / no small move in 1 h).
nervosity and movement are the ONLY two strategy dials allowed in this
file, and both exist for the same reason: neither brake has ever been
shown to make money, so switching them off is a control arm, not a new
strategy. Everything else about the structure rules stays in code and
is identical on every account.
